ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The Dengfeng Observatory in Henan County (113°E,34°N) is the earliest existing ancient astronomical observatory building in China. There are two small houses on the observatory, a crossbeam between the small houses, and a “long embankment” due north below the platform (see the following figure). Every noon, the shadow of the crossbeam falls on the “long embankment,” and it can be used to understand changes in the starry sky in the four seasons. Read the following graphic and textual materials and answer questions 10—12. <image1> During the period when the Earth moves from position Bing to position Yi, the noon projection of the crossbeam on the “long embankment” moves day by day toward (write the direction).

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The Dengfeng Observatory in Henan County (113°E,34°N) is the earliest existing ancient astronomical observatory building in China. There are two small houses on the observatory, a crossbeam between the small houses, and a “long embankment” due north below the platform (see the following figure). Every noon, the shadow of the crossbeam falls on the “long embankment,” and it can be used to understand changes in the starry sky in the four seasons. Read the following graphic and textual materials and answer questions 10—12. <image1> During the period when the Earth moves from position Bing to position Yi, the noon projection of the crossbeam on the “long embankment” moves day by day toward (write the direction).
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: The photo on the left shows the Observatory building. The position between the two small houses above is labeled “crossbeam,” and the facility extending forward below the platform is labeled “long embankment.” The question stem states that this “long embankment” is located due north below the platform. The schematic diagram on the right is the Earth’s orbit of revolution, with the Sun in the middle, and the Earth’s positions labeled Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding, among which Bing is below the orbit and Yi is on the right side of the orbit.
Then reason: According to the tilt direction of the Earth’s axis in the right figure and the relationship of the four-season positions, during the period when the Earth moves from position Bing to position Yi, it corresponds to the Northern Hemisphere moving from around the autumnal equinox toward around the winter solstice, and the direct solar point moves south day by day. Dengfeng, Henan is located at 34°N and belongs to the mid-latitude region of the Northern Hemisphere. The noon Sun is in the south, so the shadow of the crossbeam is cast toward the long embankment in the north. When the direct solar point moves south, the local noon solar altitude decreases day by day, and the noon shadow of the crossbeam becomes longer day by day; the long embankment is due north, so the projection will move north along the long embankment day by day.
